title: Chapter 200 Is Jin Lin A Thing In The Pond?
content:
Chapter 200 Is Jin Lin A Thing In The Pond?

Everyone followed Wei Shi into the county official's office, and a familiar feeling came to them.

At that time, Heifu had just arrived in this era not long ago. He was just a small soldier and his life was precarious. Relying on the opportunity he seized while performing martial arts, he was appreciated by Du Xian and asked Chen Baijiang to call him here and ask him a question.

Are you willing to be an official?

In the blink of an eye, more than two years have passed.

Heifu still remembered the old jujube tree in the courtyard that looked like a canopy. Now there were no leaves left on the tree, which made it feel quite desolate.

After entering the hospital, the others were taken by the clerk to submit "to", which is the certificate of completion of service. Heifu was led into the hall by Wei Shi. When he was taking off his shoes in front of the hall, Heifu suddenly remembered that when he first came here, he had just finished the hard work of Chengdan corvee, and he didn't even have socks, and he had to be naked. Walking on the cold floor.

Further inside, the layout of the hall has not changed much. On the left is a bookshelf with bamboo slips, and on the right is a "Lanqi" with five weapons: spears, halberds, bows, swords, and guns. The county's Youwei and Zuo Wei was sitting in the middle, all dressed in black and wearing bamboo crowns, waiting for Hei Fu.

Zuo Wei is an old acquaintance, so of course no introduction is needed, while Right Wei is a new face. He is Zheng Shou from Yingchuan who was transferred after Hei Fu served in the army. His title is the 8th-level Duke.

Two years ago, Mr. Hei had to walk over and kneel down to the two of them as soon as he entered the door. But now that he was here, the right lieutenant Zheng Shou immediately smiled and stood up first regardless of his dignity as a county lieutenant. Seeing that the top handle was moved, Zuo Wei Yunman couldn't help but continue to sit, so he had to stand up to greet this "little pavilion chief" whom he hated so much.

"Heifu has met two county captains."

Hei Fu bowed slightly, this was not Na Da, he was an official now. According to the rules of the Qin State, even if he met the county magistrate, he could bow without bowing, let alone two county captains with the same title as him.

The right lieutenant and the left lieutenant also bowed their hands to him in return.

"Although I have never met Mr. Hei, after I came to Anlu, I heard a lot about your deeds when you were the chief of the pavilion. You are really a rare official. After you went to the army, you made many meritorious deeds. I have always wanted to meet you. After seeing you, I was shocked that you are so young..."

Zheng Shou is almost forty years old, and there is a sense of twilight in his speech. Heifu just celebrated his twentieth birthday on the winter solstice last month. He is indeed enviably young. He is an official at such a young age. What about years later? It’s really unimaginable.

"I am a younger generation. I relied on a little luck to suddenly receive a reward. I am sincerely frightened. I hope you will give me more guidance in the future."

Zheng Shou took the initiative to show his kindness, and Heifu was of course humble in his words, but he also heard that the new right lieutenant was not as good as his predecessor Du Xianyuan, he was cowardly, and the power of the county lieutenant's office was in the hands of left lieutenant.

However, as long as you are a human being, you cannot be willing to be an empty puppet or a stamp. This time Heifu and the others return, might it be a good opportunity for Youwei to counterattack and seize power?

After a few words of greetings, Zheng Shou asked Hei Fu to sit down. He sat on the left side, just opposite Zuo Wei Yunman. The status of the two seemed to be equal.

Their eyes met, Hei Fu grinned, and Zuo Wei actually smiled at him, as if the previous holiday had never happened. This actually surprised Heifu. In his impression, Yun Man had always been a very sophisticated and patient person.

The two of them were silent there, and the atmosphere was a bit awkward. The only voice left in the hall was the voice of the county right lieutenant Zheng Shou.

Zheng asked Heifu about the situation on the front line. Heifu only hid some confidential things and told everything else.

"After the snow fell in late November, the fighting basically stopped. The Chu army retreated, and our army also began to withdraw its troops. We dismissed the old soldiers who had expired and went home..."

Even if the King of Qin is still unwilling to accept this war, the basic laws must be followed when recruiting troops. Like the soldiers of Nanjun, if they are forced to serve outside, their morale will only be further reduced, and at the same time, it will cause dissatisfaction among the counties and counties about the war. It is better to demobilize them. Another group was recruited, so Hei Fu and others were able to return home.

Hei Fu knew in his heart that the King of Qin would never give up. The spring plowing would end early and the autumn harvest would be late. When the country came out of the shadow of failure, a new mobilization order would be issued. That would be a real nationwide war!

Anlu County will certainly not be spared.

But those matters were naturally issued by orders. Heifu no longer had a military rank and could not intervene on his behalf. At most, he could kindly remind the right lieutenant of the county and tell him that the two countries were still in a state of hostility and that he could not relax his efforts to update the local troops. Training, that's all.

At this time, the right lieutenant of the county also mentioned the county's arrangements for these "combat heroes". They had made great contributions and returned, and their social status had risen. Of course, they could no longer continue to be small officials as before, and the King of Qin was praising Li You in his edict. Here, all counties and counties must be entrusted with important responsibilities for the soldiers who have made meritorious service this time, so they dare not let them idle at home, lest they be said to be cold-blooded people who have made meritorious deeds.

"Everyone has meritorious service, of course I must put them to good use!"

Right Lieutenant Zheng Shou changed from his usual cowardice and was extremely strong today. He didn't ask for Yun Man's opinion at all and made the decision himself. Yun Man moved his lips but did not raise any objection.

"but……"

Zheng Shou said: "Heifu is now an official. It is too young to be a military historian or traveler. I can no longer arrange for you here..."

Just as he finished speaking, the military officer outside came again and reported that the county magistrate's office nearby invited a black official!

"Sure enough." The right lieutenant smiled and said: "The county magistrate heard that you have returned and can't wait to see you. As for how to arrange your position, it is up to the county monarch!"

Hei Fu stood up. At this time, he turned around and walked up to Zuo Wei Yunman, who had said nothing today. He cupped his hands and said with a smile: "Speaking of which, if Zuo Wei hadn't asked me to escort the prisoners to serve northward, Hei Fu would never have been able to do so. With today's opportunity. Heifu, I would like to express my gratitude to Zuo Wei on behalf of himself and the soldiers who returned home with me. As an elder, Zuo Wei has really spared no effort in promoting the young people from this county!"

Yun Man's face suddenly turned blue and white, and he was almost going to have a seizure.

But in the end, he swallowed it down, regained his composure, and said with a smile as if nothing had happened: "Official officials are so humble. There will be many more days for you and me to work together in the future!"

…

"Official official, what position did you get?"

Half an hour later, when Heifu walked out of the county magistrate's office, eight of his men were still waiting outside. Seeing him coming out, they hurriedly gathered around to ask.

But Hei Fu gave it up, looked at everyone and said with a smile: "Let's talk about it, what position did you each get?"

Dongmen Bao no longer felt sad about not having a son, and said with a smile: "Your lieutenant arranged for me to go on a tour to the northern suburbs."

In the Qin State, the position of local wanderer corresponded to that of the officials and officials. It was considered preferential treatment to let Dongmen Leopard serve as wanderer. With Dongmen Leopard's evil reputation, it was easy to frighten thieves and young men in the township.

Xiao Tao also stammered: "You... Your lieutenant asked me to be the commander of the camp and train... to train the archers."

Xiao Tao's strength is his accurate archery. In the past two years, as his life has improved, the 19-year-old has continued to grow in stature. He is now over seven feet tall and can shoot stronger bows and arrows. His shortcoming is that he is slow to speak, but as a military commander who is only responsible for training, he is more than adequate. What's more, there is a garrison with a noble title who has been assigned to be his special strength and can speak for him.

Hei Fu taught him: "Don't be nervous. Strength speaks for itself in the military camp. When the time comes, you can demonstrate your bow skills and everyone will be convinced."

In addition, Ji Ying was arranged to be the postal clerk of Zhenshui Township, in charge of the post office of the township.

Several other lords were either pavilion chiefs or seeking robbers, and most of them were arranged near their homes.

Only Li Xian was thoughtful, and Heifu asked him, and he said: "I was recruited to the county to be a military historian..."

It just so happens that this position is consistent with Li Xian's characteristics of carefulness and planning.

Li Xian touched his chin and said: "The positions we have been given are all in line with our wishes, and they are all near the countryside. The right lieutenant is not familiar with us, and he does not know the talents of everyone. How can we arrange them so well? Could it be that it is? …”

He looked at Heifu.

"Not bad." Hei Fu then smiled and said, "I was the one who made the suggestion to Lieutenant You. Are the second and third sons satisfied with this new position?"

"Just what we wanted!" Everyone bowed and thanked him, and were even more grateful to Hei Fu. After all, he had been a soldier under Hei Fu for more than a year, so he really understood everyone.

Heifu's guess was correct. Right Lieutenant Zheng Shou indeed wanted to take advantage of this opportunity to counterattack and seize power. And the return of Heifu and the others just gave him a large number of ready-made candidates, who can be placed in various positions in the county captain system, squeezing Zuo Wei Yunman's old cronies. It was really a pillow for him when he was dozing off. Of course, Heifu also They were happy to see their "clique" take root and grow in the county, so the two hit it off and formed a tacit "alliance".

"After you take office, you must be respectful to the right lieutenant and obey his orders." But Heifu is also confident. The right lieutenant is an airborne officer and has no local roots. He changes every few years. At the critical moment, everyone will still listen. own words.

"The officials haven't said yet what position the county magistrate has arranged for you." Ji Ying asked curiously.

Hei Fu said disapprovingly: "Before the county magistrate spoke, I said that I had just returned from the front line and suffered a minor injury. I planned to rest at home for a while and did not plan to become an official immediately."

"Why is this!" Dongmen Bao was shocked.

"nonsense!"

Li Xian glared at them: "Is there any position in this small Anlu County that can accommodate officials?"

Everyone thought so. Originally, the number of local officials and officials in Anlu County could be counted on one hand. It would be a bit unfair for Heifu to be appointed as a rural mistress, a granary mistress, and other officials, but the three positions of chief official, jailer, and left lieutenant who are worthy of this title are not vacant.

"Yes, rather than embarrass the county magistrate, it is better to politely decline first."

Hei Fu said this, but in his heart he disliked the fish pond in Anlu County for being too small.

He is originally a golden lin, and when he swims in Yunmeng Daze, how can he be satisfied with being a thing in the pond?

Heifu is waiting for Li You's promise! It’s time to get the first return for the favors you sent earlier.

Before that, he could just cook salted fish leisurely at home for a few days. After traveling for more than a year, Heifu felt that his bones were about to fall apart...

However, after Heifu said goodbye to everyone and rode back on horseback, his group of men did not disperse. Instead, they were called back together by Li Xian and whispered.

"Actually, there is another way to create vacancies in the county that are suitable for officials."

"What method?" Dongmen Bao, Li Xian and others quickly pricked up their ears.

"It's very simple."

Li Xian said darkly: "Let Lieutenant Zuo be blamed and dismissed from office!"
